properties.summary: Mission Bay is largely built, so only the two plan blocks official sources show as still to come are drawn: Block 4 East (affordable housing, entitled with building permits issued in 2026) and Block 12 West (an affordable housing site with no project yet). Both are illustrative: each parcel is drawn to its height limit in the Mission Bay South Design for Development (65-ft base, 160-ft towers, and 250 ft on the northern half of Block 4 East), not as a building design. Completed buildings, including the most recent (Block 1's hotel, Blocks 9 and 9A, and 1450 Owens Street), are already in the base map. Not drawn: the entitled Warriors hotel and residential building on Blocks 29-30, which has no start date or official footprint; UCSF's campus; parks and streets.
properties.note: Only the blocks left to build are drawn, to their height limits rather than as designs; the rest of Mission Bay is already built.

properties.label: Block 4 East (north)
properties.source: illustrative: drawn to the height limit, not a building design: 250 ft for affordable housing on the northern half of Block 4 East (Mission Bay South Redevelopment Plan (as amended by Ordinance 022-26, Feb 13, 2026), Sec. 304.5, p. 20; Height Zone Chart, p. 24 footnote); base height 65 ft in HZ-3, Mission Bay South Design for Development (OCII, as amended Nov 17, 2025), Map 4 "Height", p. 22 and Height Zone Chart, p. 24 (https://sfocii.org/files/2026-08/Design%20for%20Development%20for%20the%20Mission%20Bay%20South%20Project%20Area%20November%2017%2C%202025.pdf); footprint: assessor parcel 8711029B in DataSF Parcels – Active and Retired (https://data.sf.gov/d/acdm-wktn), split into equal-area halves parallel to Mission Rock Street (approximate); block named on the OCII Mission Bay Land Use Map, October 2023; status: MOHCD Affordable Housing Pipeline (DataSF) (https://data.sf.gov/d/aaxw-2cb8) and DBI permits (https://data.sf.gov/d/i98e-djp9)
properties.note: Northern half of Block 4 East (approximate split): 250-ft limit for affordable housing, 65-ft base height. Entitlement approved Nov 18, 2025; DBI building permits 202512161871 (16 stories, 165 homes) and 202512172072 (23 stories, 233 homes) issued in 2026. MOHCD lists both phases as pre-construction, starting 2027 and 2028.
